title: Building Simple Apps in Thunkable — Review Quiz

questions.question: Which component would you use to let a user type a search query into your app?
A student wants to display a welcome message that the user cannot edit. Which component should they use?
Which component would you use to display a profile picture in your app?
Which of the following is something a Button can do in Thunkable?
answers: Display read-only text on the screen
Trigger the device's camera to take a photo

questions.question: A developer needs the user to enter their email address into the app. Which component should they use?
Under which section in the blocks toolbox can you find the Speech and Camera blocks?
A developer adds a Label, a Button, a Text Input, and an Image to their screen. Which component will the user be able to type into?
What does the `say` block need in order to work?
answers: A piece of text and a language to speak it in
An audio file and a volume level
A URL and a language code

questions.question: What type of output does the `recognized speech` block produce?
answers: A text transcription of what was spoken

questions.question: What does the `translation` block do?
answers: It reads text aloud in a selected language
It converts text from one language to another
It changes the language of the entire app interface

questions.question: You want your app to listen to a user speak in French and then display the French words as text on the screen. Which block and component do you need?
answers: `recognized speech` block (set to French) and a Label
`photo from camera` block and an Image

questions.question: You want to build an app where the user types a word in English and hears it spoken aloud in English. Which block do you need?

You are building an app where a user speaks a sentence in English, the app converts it to text, translates that text to German, and then displays the German text on screen. Which blocks and components do you need?
What happens when the `photo from camera` block runs?
answers: It saves a photo to the device's gallery
It opens the device's camera so the user can take a photo
It downloads an image from the internet
It displays a previously saved image

questions.question: What kind of input does the `description of image from` block need?
answers: A text description typed by the user
An image (such as one from the `photo from camera` block)

questions.question: You want to build an app that takes a photo and then displays a written description of what is in the photo on the screen. Which blocks and components do you need?
answers: `photo from camera`, `description of image from`, and a Label
`recognized speech`, `description of image from`, and a Label

questions.question: You are building an accessibility app. The user takes a photo of an object, the app identifies the object, and reads the description aloud. Which blocks do you need?
answers: `photo from camera`, `description of image from`, and `say`

questions.question: You are building a voice-powered translator. The user taps a button, speaks a sentence in English, the app translates it to Korean, and displays the Korean text on screen. Which components and blocks do you need?

You are building a travel assistant app. The user takes a photo of a street sign, the app identifies the text on the sign, translates it from Spanish to English, and speaks the English translation aloud. Which blocks do you need?
answers: `photo from camera`, `description of image from`, `translation`, and `say`
`photo from camera`, `description of image from`, and `recognized speech`
